title: An admin service must not become public
description: Two ways to put an admin service on the public plane: a router that lists both entrypoints (routes/registry.yaml), and an admin service attached to the public network (topology.yaml).
pass_criterion: Both are refused: verdict BLOCKED, exit code 2, the finding names the file and the item that draw the edge, the accepted table contains zero admin-public edges, and an independent reference computes the same edge on the table as loaded.
lesson: The admin plane is a property of the table that is checked, not a convention that is remembered.
